method.name: adjustLayout
method.shortdesc: Adjust the existing layout according to new page size, bleed and margin values. The first parameter is a plain object with key value pairs for properties affected. Permissible keys are width, height, bleedInside, bleedTop, bleedOutside, bleedBottom, leftMargin, topMargin, rightMargin, bottomMargin. The values can be specified as decimal numbers in units of Pt or as a string having a measurement value such as '1 in'. Not all properties need to be specified, only the values that need updation. Notice that when dealing with individual pages rather than the whole document, bleed changes has no effect. E.g. - app.activeDocument.adjustLayout({width:'600px', leftMargin: '1in'}), app.activeDocument.adjustLayout({rightMargin:'1in'}, app.activeDocument.spreads[0].pages), app.activeDocument.spreads[0].pages[0].adjustLayout({width:'400px', leftMargin: '10px'})
